title: Some Silicon Valley city programs are missing
text: Los Altos city teen programs and Cupertino Leaders in Training are not listed yet. Those pages did not give ages or dates when we last read them.

title: Some East Bay city programs are missing
text: Pleasanton and Livermore library teen volunteers are not listed yet. San Leandro, Union City and Fremont are listed, but the San Leandro and Fremont commission pages do not say how to apply.

title: Hospital teen volunteering is only partly covered
text: Kaiser Permanente and Sutter Davis may have teen volunteer programs we could not confirm. Alta Bates Summit and Alameda Health System are 18 and up, so they are not listed.

title: Davis and West Sacramento summer jobs are not posted yet
text: City lifeguard and camp counselor jobs were not posted when we last checked in October. Seasonal jobs are usually posted in winter and spring, so check the City of Davis and City of West Sacramento job pages then. Davis Junior Basketball is hiring teens now.

title: A few cards say Confirm first
text: These cards were not read on the program's own page, usually because the site blocked us. Check the details on the official site before you rely on them.

title: Boys and Girls Clubs are only partly covered
text: Only Oakland has a teen job card. Other clubs did not post teen details on their official pages.

title: Some Southern California city pages could not be read
text: Costa Mesa's youth pages do not state job ages, and Anaheim, Fullerton and several LA museum and hospital pages blocked our reader. Santa Ana and Anaheim are thin here.

title: Some Atlanta pages could not be read
text: The City of Atlanta's own Summer Youth Employment pages and the airport's youth workforce programs blocked our reader, so pay and signup details come from other official pages.

title: New York Parks, NYPL and several museums are missing
text: NYC Parks, the New York Public Library and the AMNH, Met and MoMA teen pages blocked our reader, so those programs are not listed yet.

title: Some Chicago and Elgin pages could not be read
text: The Cook County Forest Preserves Conservation Corps, Elgin's School District U-46 career pages and the Hoffman Estates parks pages blocked our reader.

title: Pacific Northwest and Vancouver
text: Some Seattle and Vancouver library, Park Board, hospital and museum pages blocked our reader, so those programs are not listed yet.

title: Texas and Twin Cities
text: Children's Minnesota, Hennepin Healthcare, the Minneapolis Institute of Art and Austin's workforce youth program blocked our reader, so those programs are not listed yet.

title: Midwest campuses
text: Madison and Parks jobs, Indiana hospital and city pages, Ohio state pages and University of Michigan programs blocked our reader. Ohio's 2026 minimum wage is not on the site yet.

title: East Coast
text: Durham and Raleigh youth jobs, several Maryland and Philadelphia hospitals and libraries, and the Massachusetts state pages blocked our reader.

title: Santa Barbara, Merced, San Diego and Inland Empire
text: City of Merced and UC Merced, Cottage Health, Riverside County workforce and the City of Pomona blocked our reader, so those programs are not listed yet.
